perfume.answer: JAL allows toiletry articles in carry-on and checked baggage, less than 0.5 kg or 0.5 L per container and less than 2 kg or 2 L per person, with spray nozzles protected.

sections.h: 🧴 What Japan Airlines says about perfume and aerosols
sections.p: From the JAL international-flights page "About the restricted articles in checked and carry-on baggage", section "Toiletry Articles and Medicines", read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Japan Airlines rule
rows: Less than 2 kg or 2 L in total
The nozzle must be protected with a cap or similar device so it cannot be activated
Hair spray, hair tonic, hair colour and bleach, lotion, facial cleansing foam, sunscreen, shaving foam, nail care products
The separate rule for carry-on liquids, gels and aerosols also applies

list: Not on the page: the part of the page read does not list perfume by name; it covers toiletry articles by category.

faq: How much of my toiletries can I carry on JAL?
Less than 0.5 kg or 0.5 L per container and less than 2 kg or 2 L per person, in carry-on or checked baggage.
Do aerosol cans need a cap on JAL?
Yes, gas-filled spray cans must have the nozzle protected so it cannot be activated.
